name: Nømad Coffee Lab
note: The flagship lab of Nømad — bright, acid-driven filters and a rotating single-origin espresso. Tiny, intense, no laptops.

name: Nømad Coffee Productions
note: Sibling outfit at the same Passatge Sert address — green-bean cupping room and small-batch production roasting.

name: SlowMov
note: Pioneer roaster in Vila de Gràcia. Honest, clean coffees and warm pastries on a quiet corner — locals' favourite.

name: Right Side Coffee Bar
note: Tucked into the Gothic Quarter inside Hotel Casa Bonay. Reliable flat whites and an all-day Japanese-leaning menu.

name: Three Marks Coffee
note: Modern espresso bar in Eixample. Light roasts, multi-roaster guest beans, attentive baristas — a serious cup.

name: Cafés El Magnífico
note: Family-run since 1919, but specialty-focused since the early 2000s. Wide bean selection by weight.

name: Onna Coffee
note: Gràcia roaster with their own farm in Honduras. Honey-processed lots feature regularly — sit at the bar.

name: Skye Coffee Co.
note: Inside Espacio 88 in Poblenou. Vintage Citroën-van vibe, brews from rotating European roasters, courtyard seating.

name: Hidden Coffee Roasters
note: Slim Raval spot doing their own roasting. Excellent V60 program, great cardamom buns — easy to miss, worth the hunt.

name: Espai Joliu
note: Poblenou hybrid: monstera-lined café with a tight specialty menu. Filter-only on Saturdays — bring a notebook.
